summary: Polygon's weekend deals roundup for the week of The Game Awards 2023 highlights Steam discounts on Game Awards winners and nominees, the Xbox Series X matching its Black Friday price, and other gaming and entertainment offers. It also covers a Criterion Collection sitewide Blu-Ray sale, a Lego Mandalorian ship, a Legend of Vox Machina vinyl soundtrack, and a portable Victrola record player.
one_line: Polygon's weekend deals roundup features Steam discounts on 2023 Game Awards winners, a $349.99 Xbox Series X, Criterion Blu-Ray sales, and entertainment gear.
key_facts: Steam is discounting many 2023 Game Awards contenders and winners from the past nine years, including Diablo 4, Starfield, Valiant Hearts, Her Story, and Celeste.
Cocoon, from a studio founded by Jeppe Carlsen (creator of Limbo and Inside), won Best Indie Game at the 2023 Game Awards.
Hi-Fi Rush won the audio design prize at the 2023 Game Awards and features licensed songs from Nine Inch Nails, The Flaming Lips, and The Prodigy.
Walmart and Amazon are selling the Xbox Series X standalone for $349.99, matching its Black Friday price and $150 off the standard price.
Amazon offers $50 Xbox Gift Cards for $45 each.
Target discounted three-month Game Pass Ultimate subscriptions to $44.99 (was $49.99).
The 8BitDo Arcade Stick for Xbox Series X is $74.99 at Woot, the best price yet for the $119.99 controller (38% off).
The Legend of Vox Machina two-disc Limited Edition vinyl soundtrack is $37.56 on Amazon, its lowest price to date, and includes exclusive tracks.
The Victrola Revolution Go record player is about $125 (normally $199.99), with a built-in speaker and up to 12 hours of battery life.
The 6,187-piece Lego Mandalorian ship of Din Djarin is $419.99 (was $599.99) on Amazon, matching its Black Friday price.
Through Dec. 22, The Criterion Collection discounts 4K UHD Blu-Rays and box sets, including Trainspotting, Time Bandits, The Godzilla Showa-Era Box Set, and Moonage Daydream.
